page.overview:
Who is Dyna-Mite?

2856195 LEGO Minifigure Ultimate Sticker Collection 852948 Female Magnet Set

Dyna-Mite is an Agents minifigure. She is especially known for her obsession with dynamite, thus the name Dyna-Mite. She has the same hair-piece as Irina Spalko, News Reporter, and Nya, except the colour is red.
